# Quartz

> Quartz is a digital news outlet covering business, technology, markets, and global affairs with focus on emerging trends and their impact on business and society.

Quartz provides in-depth coverage of business news, financial markets, artificial intelligence and technology developments, energy markets, corporate leadership, consumer trends, and geopolitical events shaping the global economy.

## Key Topics

- Business News
- Financial Markets
- Artificial Intelligence
- Technology
- Energy & Oil
- Corporate Leadership
- Geopolitics
- Consumer News
- Federal Reserve
- Meta
- Airlines & Transportation
- Media & Entertainment
- Middle East
- Oil Markets
- Corporate Strategy
